description: This topic is a crucial part of Global Geography and Static GK. It covers the major countries of the world, their capital cities, and official currencies for exam-oriented rapid revision.

sections.title: Asian Countries
sections.description: Capitals and currencies of major countries in the Asian continent, including India's neighbors.

key_concepts.explanation: The largest and most populous continent in the world, where India is located. Geopolitical questions from this region are highly emphasized in competitive exams.

key_associations.associated_with: Capital: New Delhi | Currency: Indian Rupee (INR)
key_associations.extra_info: A major economic and military power in South Asia.
The official currency is Renminbi, with Yuan being its primary base unit.
Globally known as the 'Land of the Rising Sun'.
The neighboring country that shares the longest international land border with India.
Nusantara was recently declared the new capital, shifting away from the sinking city of Jakarta.

sections.title: European Countries
sections.description: Economically and politically significant countries of the European Continent.

key_concepts.explanation: A geographic and economic region consisting of European Union (EU) member states that have fully adopted the Euro as their official currency.

key_associations.extra_info: The UK never adopted the Euro and officially exited the European Union through 'Brexit'.
The largest and most industrialized economy in the European Union.
Paris is widely regarded as the fashion capital and hosts the headquarters of UNESCO.
The largest country in the world by land area, spanning across both Eastern Europe and Northern Asia.
Rome completely enclaves Vatican City, which is the smallest sovereign state in the world.

sections.title: African Countries
sections.description: A list of geopolitically significant countries in the African continent.

key_associations.extra_info: Historically known as the 'Gift of the Nile' and controls the strategically vital Suez Canal.

key_associations.associated_with: Capitals: Pretoria, Cape Town, Bloemfontein | Currency: South African Rand
key_associations.extra_info: A unique nation with three capitals: Pretoria (Executive), Cape Town (Legislative), and Bloemfontein (Judicial).
The most populous country in Africa and a major oil producer.
Nairobi is a major diplomatic hub and hosts the headquarters of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).

sections.title: North and South American Countries
sections.description: Major countries of the Americas, their capital cities, and monetary systems.

key_associations.associated_with: Capital: Washington D.C. | Currency: US Dollar (USD)
key_associations.extra_info: The US Dollar is the world's dominant reserve currency and the primary currency used in international trade.
The country with the longest total coastline in the world.
The largest country in South America, home to the vast majority of the Amazon Rainforest.

key_associations.associated_with: Capital: Buenos Aires | Currency: Argentine Peso
key_associations.extra_info: A major agricultural exporter located in the southern half of South America.

sections.title: Currency Groups and Important Facts
sections.description: Key static GK facts regarding global currencies and unique national attributes.

key_concepts.explanation: When multiple independent nations use the same currency to facilitate economic integration and trade, such as the Euro in Europe or the CFA Franc in West/Central Africa.

important_facts.fact: The Kuwaiti Dinar (KWD) is currently the highest-valued currency in the world against the US Dollar.
The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney or Melbourne, and its official currency is the Australian Dollar (AUD).
Due to severe hyperinflation, Zimbabwe introduced a new gold-backed currency called 'Zimbabwe Gold' (ZiG) in April 2024 to stabilize its economy.
The capital of Switzerland is Bern, and its currency is the Swiss Franc (CHF), which is widely considered a premier global 'safe-haven' currency.
